items.name: Dental Bridges
items.description: Dental bridges can be created using a fixed design, which attaches to neighboring teeth with a prosthetic in the middle. There are times when an implant bridge is required if the nearby teeth aren’t healthy enough to support the bridge.

items.name: Dental Crowns
items.description: Dental crowns offer an effective alternative when the tooth’s integrity is threatened by trauma, decay, or other damage. This step helps to reduce the need for tooth extraction.

items.name: Dental Emergency
items.description: When dental emergencies happen, East Erie Dental – SE Chicago Dentistry is the team to call. We provide immediate care and same-day appointments to treat everything from a toothache to trauma. Our first step is to reduce the pain. Then we’ll design a custom plan to preserve your smile.

items.name: Dental Exam & Cleaning
items.description: Maintaining a consistent dental exam schedule is the foundation of protecting your teeth and gums. When you visit our office for an exam and cleaning, we provide a full-service experience to identify possible dental issues in the earliest stages.

items.name: Dental Fillings
items.description: Fillings are simple and easy when you are working with an experienced dental team. We offer tooth-colored fillings that create a natural, durable result that will last for years. We are proactive about early interventions whenever possible, helping to restore your tooth.

items.name: Dentures
items.description: Dentures offer an effective solution when the full restoration is required. These prosthetics can be designed to replace all teeth on both the upper and lower jaws. Or, partial dentures are available if a portion of the teeth is missing.

items.name: Emergency Dentistry
items.description: When dental emergencies happen, East Erie Dental – SE Chicago Dentistry is the team to call. We provide immediate care and same-day appointments to treat everything from a toothache to trauma. Our first step is to reduce the pain. Then we’ll design a custom plan to preserve your smile.

items.name: Gum Disease Treatment
items.description: Healthy gums act as the foundation for your teeth which is why its best to identify gum disease in the earliest stages.Small infections can develop in the gums, leading to gum recession and more oversized pockets of bacteria.Eventually, the gum tissue wastes away, which can damage the teeth as well.

items.name: LUMINEERS VENEERS
items.description: Lumineer veneers are a thin and customized cast that are placed over chipped, uneven, or discolored teeth. Luminees can also fix spacing issues and can prevent a damaged tooth from additional harm. On average, Lumineers can last for 20 years, and are stain resistant.Here at East Erie Dental – SE Chicago Dentistry, we offer Lumineers, a type of dental veneer that is soft on gums and painlessly cements onto existing teeth. the dental veneers we use are also sensitivity-free results with a quick and easy procedure

items.name: ROOT CANAL
items.description: Root canal treatment is a dental procedure (endodontic therapy) that saves a damaged or diseased tooth. Root canals are used instead of removing a damaged tooth, allowing the patient to maintain their existing bite. This treatment requires the removal of a nerve inside the tooth and replacing the empty root “canal” with a solid filling material that is infection resistant.A dark-colored tooth generally indicates that the tooth’s nerve is infected and the flow of blood to and from the tooth has stopped. Usually this means the tooth will require a root canal for treatment, though it is possible the tooth will simply “die,” not requiring a root canal to treat the pain.In order to return the tooth to its natural light color, you might consider a crown, Lumineer veneers or a procedure in which a whitening agent is placed inside the tooth after root canal treatment that whitens the tooth.

items.name: Root Canals
items.description: When an infection reaches the deep, internal portion of a tooth, a root canal is necessary to save the tooth’s structure. Through this treatment, the inner pulp and nerves are removed, leaving the tooth’s outer shell and roots.

items.name: Tooth Extractions
items.description: At East Erie Dental, we are proactive about protecting the health and structure of your natural teeth as much as possible. But there are times when a tooth is damaged beyond repair, and extraction is needed.

items.name: Teeth Whitening
items.description: Do you want a smile that shines? If you are noticing discoloration or staining on the surface of your teeth, then it might be time to schedule professional teeth whitening treatments. This service is faster and more effective than the DIY kits you can buy at the local stores.

items.description: Everyone has TMJ, in fact, you have 2 of them! TMD refers to patients who have a disorder or dysfunction within their TMJ. TMD is often referred to as the “great imposter” because its signs and symptoms can mimic dozens of other disorders. Schedule your appointment with MG Dentistry today!

items.name: Porcelain Veneers
items.description: Veneers are ultra-thin, custom-made, porcelain laminates designed to cover the front surface of your tooth. Veneers create bright, white smiles with beautifully aligned, shapely teeth. Schedule with MG Dentistry in Chicago, IL today!

items.name: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
items.description: Full mouth rehabilitation is ideal for patients who have excessively worn, broken, missing, or misaligned teeth. A full mouth rehabilitation will create teeth that have functional and stabilize your bite, joint, and facial musculature. The ultimate result, the smile you’ve always wanted!

items.name: Dental Crowns
items.description: At MG Dentistry in Chicago, IL, our cosmetic dentists are experts in the art of customizing dental crowns that will not only improve the overall function of your tooth but also improve your smile.

items.name: Cosmetic Bonding
items.description: Cosmetic bonding can restore chipped or broken teeth, fill in gaps, and reshape your mouth. Bonding is a procedure in which a composite resin is applied to the front surface of the tooth to improve appearance or restore the tooth to its original healthy state. Schedule with MG Dentistry today!

items.name: Dental Implants
items.description: Oftentimes, patients hear “dental implant” and immediately think of two things: pain and expense. Although these are legitimate concerns, the good news is that given the advancement of the procedure, neither of these are something to worry about. Schedule MG Dentistry in Chicago, IL today!

items.name: Invisalign
items.description: Invisalign straightens your smile invisibly—without bands, brackets, or wires. This clear alternative to traditional orthodontics involves removable, comfortable aligners that typically straighten teeth within a year. Schedule with MG Dentistry in Chicago, IL today!

items.name: Trios Scan
items.description: For years MG Dentistry has invested in state-of-the-art equipment in order to make dental procedures as safe, quick, and as comfortable as possible. Today we would like to introduce new, state-of-the-art technology brought to you by TRIOS. Say goodbye to messy dental impressions!

items.name: CariVu
items.description: At MG Dentistry we are constantly evolving to keep up the pace with advancing technology. One of the newest technologies in the dental field is the CariVu which allows us to provide a more accurate diagnosis of cavities, particularly “in-between” teeth cavities.

items.name: 3D Imaging Scan
items.description: Cone Scan multiple projections are processed into 3D images allowing a reproducible image of the jaws and teeth. It is a fast, non-invasive procedure that answers a multitude of clinical questions allowing us to better diagnose pathology and treatment plan our patients.

items.name: Dental Bridge
items.description: A traditional dental bridge replaces missing teeth by using the support of its two adjacent teeth. These two teeth are restored with dental crowns which are bonded to a pontic positioned in the area of the missing tooth. Schedule with MG Dentistry in Chicago, IL today!

items.name: Botox Cosmetic
items.description: BOTOX® Cosmetic is a prescription medicine that is injected into muscles and used to improve the look of moderate-to-severe frown lines between the brows in people 18 to 65 years of age for a short period of time (temporary). Schedule with MG Rejuvenation Center today!

items.name: Juvederm
items.description: Juvederm is an injectable facial filler that is used by certified professionals to soften deep folds and reduce wrinkles in faces with no recovery time. The substance is largely hyaluronic acid (HA), a substance normally found in the skin and body. Schedule with MG Rejuvenation Center today!

items.name: Voluma
items.description: Voluma is part of the Juvederm range and is a hyaluronic acid-based dermal filler. It combines with collagen and elastin to improve the skin’s structure and elasticity for results lasting up to two years with optimal treatment. Schedule with MG Rejuvenation in Chicago, IL today!

items.name: Dermal Peels
items.description: Chemical peels remove the damaged outer layer of your facial skin, improving skin tone for a brighter, smoother complexion. All of MG Rejuvenation Center’s chemical peel products are developed and formulated using superior ingredients to achieve outstanding results.

items.name: Customized Facial Rejuvenation
items.description: Facials designed specifically for your skin type are an excellent addition to any IPL, Laser Genesis, Chemical Peel, or Vibraderm package to provide the greatest aesthetic benefit and restore a more healthy, youthful appearance. Schedule with MG Rejuvenation Center in Chicago, IL today!

items.name: Laser Therapy
items.description: Laser Genesis skin therapy is an innovative, technologically advanced way to promote vibrant and healthy-looking skin in men and women. The Laser Genesis procedure has been scientifically proven to produce new collagen. Schedule with MG Rejuvenation Center in Chicago, IL today!

items.name: Hair Removal
items.description: No more painful waxing, electrolysis, or razors! Cleared for permanent hair reduction, the CoolGlide laser can treat men and women of all skin types safely and effectively, year-round. Even patients with a suntan. Schedule with MG Rejuvenation Center in Chicago, IL today!
